CREATE TABLE pc_media_assets (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	byte_digest VARCHAR(71) NOT NULL, 
	media_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	byte_size BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	descriptor BLOB NOT NULL, 
	bytes BLOB NOT NULL, 
	created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, byte_digest), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_media_asset_bytes CHECK (byte_size > 0 AND byte_size <= 8388608), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_media_asset_payload CHECK (length(bytes) = byte_size)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_media_processing_requests (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(67) NOT NULL, 
	original_source_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	original_source_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	processing_kind VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	handler_schema VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	operation VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	operation_target VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	request_digest VARCHAR(71) NOT NULL, 
	profile_digest VARCHAR(71) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	state_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	active_key VARCHAR(8), 
	due_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	claim_token VARCHAR(36), 
	claim_until BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	claim_group VARCHAR(256), 
	claim_generation BIGINT, 
	claim_holder VARCHAR(128), 
	input BLOB NOT NULL, 
	receipt BLOB NOT NULL, 
	payload BLOB NOT NULL, 
	created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, request_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_media_request_version CHECK (state_version > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_media_request_active CHECK ((active_key IS NOT NULL AND active_key = 'active' AND state IN ('pending','running','retry_wait','blocked')) OR (active_key IS NULL AND state IN ('succeeded','failed','superseded')))
)

CREATE TABLE pc_media_capacity (
	boundary VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	retained_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	active_requests INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (boundary, scope_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_media_capacity_nonnegative CHECK (retained_bytes >= 0 AND active_requests >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_media_capacity_boundary CHECK ((boundary = 'global' AND scope_id = '') OR (boundary = 'scope' AND scope_id != ''))
)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_media_active_scope ON pc_media_processing_requests (processing_kind, active_key, scope_id, state, due_at, claim_until)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_media_request_due ON pc_media_processing_requests (processing_kind, state, due_at, scope_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_media_request_page ON pc_media_processing_requests (scope_id, processing_kind, created_at, request_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_media_request_state_page ON pc_media_processing_requests (scope_id, processing_kind, state, created_at, request_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_pc_media_request_active ON pc_media_processing_requests (scope_id, original_source_type, original_source_id, processing_kind, active_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_pc_media_request_replay ON pc_media_processing_requests (scope_id, processing_kind, operation, operation_target, idempotency_key)
